findings.evidence: DBNResource.java:423-425 opens an IFile.getContents() stream; DBNPathBase.java:293-296 passes it to copyInputStream and Files.copy at line 369, which does not close supplied streams.
findings.reason: Every location-less remote-file paste leaves its newly acquired source stream unclosed on both success and failure, retaining filesystem handles or connections.

findings.evidence: A location-less IFolder has neither a Path nor the new IFile-only InputStream adapter, so DBNPathBase.java:290-301 continues without copying it.
findings.reason: The base implementation already skipped every Path-null node, while this PR is scoped to files and explicitly says directories remain unsupported; this is not a delta introduced by the patch.

findings.evidence: The diff changes only DBNResource.java and DBNPathBase.java and adds no test for the Path-null/InputStream branch.
findings.reason: Missing regression coverage alone does not establish a functional defect in the changed behavior.

findings.evidence: DBNPathBase.java:293 acquires the same IFile content stream identified by f1 and passes it to Files.copy without an owner closing it.
findings.reason: This is the same unclosed-stream defect as f1 on the same changed-line run; f1 carries the combined evidence and both lens tags.
